# Ewaste Kochi

> Kochi's government-authorized e-waste recycling and IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) company. Free doorstep pickup, certified data destruction, and the best scrap prices across all areas of Kochi, Kerala, India.

## About Ewaste Kochi

Ewaste Kochi (ewastekochi.com) is a leading e-waste management company based in Palarivattom, Kochi, Kerala. Founded in 2015, the company is ISO 14001:2015 certified and authorized by the Pollution Control Board and CPCB (Central Pollution Control Board). We serve homes, businesses, and institutions across Kochi and Greater Kerala with responsible, compliant, and profitable e-waste disposal.

**Phone:** +91 75 0055 5454
**Email:** info@ewastekochi.com
**Address:** Door No. 34/1406, 2nd Floor, Palarivattom, Kochi, Kerala – 682025, India
**Hours:** Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM IST
**Rating:** 4.9/5 from 124+ verified reviews (Google, JustDial, Sulekha)

## Services

- [E-Waste Recycling](https://ewastekochi.com/e-waste-recycling/): Free pickup and eco-friendly recycling of all electronic waste including laptops, desktops, mobiles, TVs, ACs, printers, and batteries. Zero-landfill process.
- [IT Asset Disposition – ITAD](https://ewastekochi.com/itad/): Secure, compliant disposal of corporate IT assets for businesses of all sizes. Covers data destruction, asset evaluation, value recovery, and full compliance documentation.
- [Certified Data Destruction](https://ewastekochi.com/data-destruction/): DoD 5220.22-M and NIST 800-88 compliant data wiping and physical hard drive shredding. Certificate of Destruction issued for every device.
- [Hard Drive Shredding](https://ewastekochi.com/hard-drive-shredding/): Industrial-grade physical shredding of HDDs, SSDs, tapes, and all storage media.
- [Electronic Scrap Buying](https://ewastekochi.com/scrap-price/): Best market rates for laptop, desktop, server, mobile, HDD, SSD, RAM, motherboard, GPU, printer, UPS, and battery scrap. Instant payment via cash, UPI, or bank transfer.
- [Free E-Waste Pickup](https://ewastekochi.com/pickup/): Doorstep pickup service across all areas of Kochi at no charge.

| Item | Price Range |
|------|-------------|
| Laptop | ₹1,500 – ₹4,000 per piece |
| Desktop (complete) | ₹800 – ₹2,500 per set |
| Server | ₹5,000 – ₹25,000 per piece |
| Hard Disk (HDD) | ₹150 – ₹400 per piece |
| SSD | ₹300 – ₹900 per piece |
| RAM | ₹50 – ₹300 per piece |
| Mobile Phone | ₹300 – ₹5,000 per piece |
| UPS | ₹800 – ₹2,500 per piece |
| Battery (SMF) | ₹300 – ₹1,200 per piece |

*Prices are indicative. Final price confirmed after physical evaluation.*

## Service Areas in Kochi

Kakkanad, Edappally, Fort Kochi, Kalamassery, Aluva, Palarivattom, Vyttila, Tripunithura, Willingdon Island, Panampilly Nagar, Kaloor, Thevara, Ernakulam, Thrikkakara, Perumbavoor, Angamaly, North Paravur, and all other areas in and around Kochi / Ernakulam district.
